display_long_description:
Weave is a VR game about web-swinging, and about the people you swing with.

Your hands are your web shooters. Fire a web at a rooftop or a tree trunk, let go of the ground, and swing. Build up speed, chain your swings together, and see how far you can get without ever touching the ground.

Jump in with other players in the City or the Forest and play infection, or just hang out and mess around. Voice chat lets you talk to whoever is nearby.

Playing solo? There's plenty to do:
• Time trials with a ghost of your best run and a leaderboard to climb
• Hidden coins to find around each map
• Daily challenges that change every day

Make your gorilla your own. Spend coins on hats, faces, body gear, and different cosmetics in the shop, and check yourself out in the mirror. There are also optional mod packs that change how you move, like extra speed and stronger swings. They work in casual lobbies and are switched off in infection, so everyone plays fair.

Weave is in Early Access. We're still adding maps, game modes, cosmetics, and more, and we'd love to hear what you want to see next!
